# [0.2.0-nightly.146](https://github.com/itsoltech/canopy/compare/v0.2.0-nightly.145...v0.2.0-nightly.146) (2026-11-13)

### Bug Fixes

* **threads:** keep drafts after reconnect ([#592](https://github.com/itsoltech/canopy/issues/592)) ([012abcd](https://github.com/itsoltech/canopy/commit/012abcdef))

### Features

* **updates:** show `What's new` after an update ([#593](https://github.com/itsoltech/canopy/pull/593)) ([abcdef0](https://github.com/itsoltech/canopy/commit/abcdef0123))
  with links to each change
* add compact settings (#594)

### Performance Improvements

* **files:** open large diffs faster ([765abcd](https://github.com/itsoltech/canopy/commit/765abcdef))

### BREAKING CHANGES

* Internal migration instructions
